title: Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026 Time-Table & Shift Timings Released
summary: The Union Public Service Commission has officially published the comprehensive schedule for the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026. Forenoon sessions run from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and afternoon sessions run from 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM. Candidates can download their e-Admit cards 3 weeks prior to commencement.
key_takeaways: Forenoon sessions: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM | Afternoon sessions: 2:30 PM - 5:30 PM
e-Admit cards to be hosted on upsc.gov.in 3 weeks prior to exam commencement
No entry permitted into test centers 10 minutes prior to session start

title: Combined Graduate Level (Tier-I) Examination 2026 Provisional Answer Key & Challenge Portal Live
summary: Staff Selection Commission has uploaded tentative answer keys along with candidate response sheets for CGL (Tier-I) Examination 2026 on ssc.gov.in. Representations in respect of the tentative answer keys may be submitted online from 15 Sep to 19 Sep on payment of Rs. 100 per question challenged.
key_takeaways: Challenge portal open from 15 Sep (6:00 PM) to 19 Sep (6:00 PM)
Fee: Rs. 100 per question/answer challenged under statutory procedure
Response sheets cannot be accessed after the challenge window closes

title: National Testing Agency Notifies Examination Schedule for JEE (Main) 2027 Session 1
summary: NTA announces that Session 1 of Joint Entrance Examination (Main) 2027 will be conducted between 22 January and 31 January 2027 across 300+ Indian cities and 25 international centers in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. Online registration opens first week of November 2026.
key_takeaways: Session 1 exam window: 22 January - 31 January 2027 (CBT Mode)
Online registration portal opens first week of November 2026 on jeemain.nta.nic.in
Syllabus remains aligned to rationalized NCERT Class 11 and 12 curriculum

title: Online Preliminary Examination Call Letters for Probationary Officers (CRP PO/MT-XIV) Released
summary: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection has made available online call letters for the Preliminary Examination for recruitment of Probationary Officers / Management Trainees in participating public sector banks. Candidates must bring recent passport photograph matching registration.
key_takeaways: Download window active on ibps.in until date of examination
Mandatory documents: Original valid Photo ID + photocopy + call letter with photo pasted
Biometric fingerprint / IRIS capture mandatory at entry checkpoint

title: National Defence Academy & Naval Academy Examination (II) 2026 Written Results Gazetted
summary: UPSC has declared the roll-number wise list of candidates who qualified in the NDA & NA (II) 2026 written test. Shortlisted candidates are required to register on the Indian Army recruiting website joinindianarmy.nic.in within two weeks for Services Selection Board (SSB) interview call-ups.
key_takeaways: Qualified roll numbers published in official Gazette Press Release
Mandatory registration on joinindianarmy.nic.in within two weeks of result declaration
SSB interviews scheduled tentatively between November 2026 and January 2027

title: Railway Recruitment Boards Issue Addendum Notifying 11,558 Non-Technical Popular Category Posts
summary: The Ministry of Railways has notified Centralized Employment Notice (CEN) for 11,558 graduate and undergraduate level posts across all 21 Railway Recruitment Boards. Posts include Goods Train Manager, Station Master, Senior Clerk cum Typist, and Junior Account Assistant.
key_takeaways: Total vacancy count: 11,558 posts across 21 regional RRB boards
Graduate Level posts: Pay Level 5 and 6 (Basic ₹29,200 - ₹35,400)
Undergraduate Level posts: Pay Level 2 and 3 (Basic ₹19,900 - ₹21,700)

title: Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services (Prelims) Exam 2026 Rescheduled to 27 October
summary: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission, Prayagraj has issued a revised public notice rescheduling the Combined State / Senior Subordinate Services Preliminary Examination 2026 to Sunday, 27 October 2026 across 75 district centers in Uttar Pradesh due to administrative synchronization.
key_takeaways: New preliminary examination date: Sunday, 27 October 2026
Shift 1 (General Studies-I): 9:30 AM - 11:30 AM
Shift 2 (General Studies-II / CSAT): 2:30 PM - 4:30 PM
Admit cards to be issued 10 days prior to examination on uppsc.up.nic.in

title: IIT Roorkee Activates GOAPS Registration Portal for GATE 2027
summary: The GATE Online Application Processing System (GOAPS) is now active for Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE 2027). A candidate can appear in up to two test papers out of the 30 available subject disciplines. Normal application closing date is 26 September 2026.
key_takeaways: Organizing Institute: IIT Roorkee
Application deadline without late fee: 26 September 2026
Examination dates: 6, 7, 13 & 14 February 2027 in full CBT mode

title: IIM Kozhikode Announces Common Admission Test (CAT 2026) Registration Deadline Extension
summary: The convenor of CAT 2026 has extended the online registration window until 20 September 2026 (5:00 PM). Candidates can choose up to 6 preferred test cities. The computer-based test will be held on Sunday, 29 November 2026 across 3 sessions.
key_takeaways: Extended registration window closes 20 September 2026 at 5:00 PM
Examination Date: Sunday, 29 November 2026 (3 sessions)
Test duration: 120 minutes with 40 minutes strictly allocated per section

title: Reserve Bank of India Issues Examination Centers & Timing for Phase-II (DR - General)
authority_full: Reserve Bank of India Services Board
summary: Reserve Bank of India Services Board, Mumbai has notified the shift matrix for Phase-II examination for recruitment of Officers in Grade 'B' (DR - General). Paper-III (Finance & Management) and Paper-I (Economic & Social Issues) comprise 50% objective and 50% descriptive typing questions.
key_takeaways: Morning Shift: Paper-III (Finance & Management) — 90 mins objective + descriptive
Afternoon Shift: Paper-I (ESI) & Paper-II (English Writing Skills)
Descriptive answers must be typed on computer keyboards in English

title: NMC & NTA Joint Clarification Regarding Mandatory Subjects & Open School Eligibility
summary: National Medical Commission issues statutory guidance affirming that candidates who studied Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology along with English as additional subjects or from open schools (NIOS) remain eligible to sit for NEET (UG) 2027 admission to MBBS/BDS programs.
key_takeaways: Open school (NIOS) candidates confirmed eligible under NMC guidelines
Biology/Biotechnology taken as additional subject after 10+2 recognized
Lower age limit remains 17 years completed as of 31 December of admission year

title: 70th Integrated Combined (Preliminary) Competitive Examination Notified for 1,957 Vacancies
summary: Bihar Public Service Commission, Patna has invited online applications for the 70th Integrated Combined Competitive Examination for 1,957 administrative posts including Sub-Divisional Officer, Deputy Superintendent of Police, and Commercial Tax Officer. Preliminary exam scheduled for 13 December 2026.
key_takeaways: Total posts: 1,957 across Bihar Administrative and Police Services
Preliminary Exam date: 13 December 2026
Negative marking: 1/3rd mark deducted per incorrect answer
